trigger.problem: OpenDigger code_change_lines_sum can be negative, contradicting the assumed nonnegative magnitude semantics.

source_verification.correct_semantics: net code-size change (additions minus deletions), not total code-change magnitude

decision.reason: The original construct interpretation failed source-semantic verification. Reinterpreting it post hoc as a new baseline covariate would add an unmotivated construct after outcome values became available.

corrected_models.A: ln_open_age = beta1*ln_resolution + beta2*ln_issues_new + beta3*ln_contributors + project_FE + month_FE + error
corrected_models.B: asinh_backlog = beta1*ln_resolution + beta2*ln_issues_new + beta3*ln_contributors + project_FE + month_FE + error
corrected_models.C: ln_resolution = theta1*ln_issues_new + theta2*ln_contributors + project_FE + month_FE + error
corrected_models.D: ln_open_age = theta1*ln_issues_new + theta2*ln_contributors + project_FE + month_FE + error
